name: Sheralee Wootton
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Drawing on modalities such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, and Schema Therapy. Treatment areas include kink-specific support, PTSD, childhood sexual trauma and long term/complex trauma.
specialties: schema therapy, gender-affirming care, WPATH assessments, LGBTQIA+, gender-diverse, kink-specific support, sexual trauma, complex trauma, sexual pain
